You shouldn't need to do anything as drastic as pay for installation
help unless you've _really_ FUBAR'd your system.

What's your OS and what did you do before what went wrong went wrong?
If you are getting arguments about masked .GlobalEnv and as.Date, I'd
assume you can get R to work in general.

Try going to the command line and trying

R --vanilla

which should give you a 'clean room' R

MW
